title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PMKMY):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PMKMY):

items: PMKMY is a pension scheme launched on 12th September 2019 to provide economic security to
o Eligibility: Farmers with land up to 2 hectares, aged 18-40 years.
o Premium: Rs. 55 to 200 per month, depending on age.
12	ONE STOP SOLUTION FOR IAS, RAS, SI
o Pension: Rs. 3000 per month after the age of 60.
o Spouse Benefit: In case of death, the spouse can continue receiving the pension.
o Government Contribution: The government matches the farmer’s contribution.
o Implementing Agency: LIC (Life Insurance Corporation of India).
o Objective: To provide financial security and social welfare to farmers in their old age.
o Enrollment: Farmers can enroll through Common Service Centers (CSCs).
